lina (docs): FYI: noticed several docs pages where inline code in headings breaks the in-page links. e.g. `## Using `--fast` mode` ends up with no consistent id and the sidebar link 404s.
omar (eng): that's unfortunate. any log sample?
lina (docs): from the build: `WARNING: Missing fragment for /guides/perf.html#using-%60--fast%60-mode` — the link from the nav referenced `#using--fast-mode` but the generated id had extra backticks or odd encoding.
tara (devex): this smells like the markdown parser changed how it treats backticks in header slugs after our upgrade. a few quick approaches: add explicit ids, escape the inline code, or normalize slugs post-build.
omar (eng): short term I'd prefer explicit ids on critical pages. long term we should align the markdown-it slugifier to strip inline code consistently.
lina (docs): i pulled the 5 affected pages: guides/perf.md, guides/cli.md, tutorials/setup.md, api/flags.md, and recipes/optim.md.
omar (eng): can you paste one broken header and the suggested explicit id?
lina (docs): header: `### Using `--fast` mode for benchmarks` suggested id: `### Using `--fast` mode for benchmarks {#using-fast-mode}`
omar (eng): ok. i'll fast-track a tiny script to add ids where headers contain inline code and no existing id. i'll open a PR with the automation + manual checks.
tara (devex): if you add the script, please include a dry-run flag and unit test so we don't accidentally mangle headings. also add a note in the PR describing the slug rule we're enforcing.
omar (eng): will do. quick snippet i'm using for detection:```python
import re
h=re.compile(r"^(#{1,6})\s*(.+)`(.+)`(.+)$")
# replacement builds kebab id from combined parts
```
lina (docs): nice. I can also add a tiny linkcheck assertion in CI that fails if any sidebar link points to a missing fragment (helps catch regressions).
ci-bot: queued linkcheck run on branch docs/inline-code-id-fix (job #524).
omar (eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/513 — automation + manual fixes for the five pages, plus unit test and README note. assigning @lina for review.
lina (docs): reviewing now. small nit: use `--dry-run` by default in script when no `--apply` flag passed.
omar (eng): good call, updated.
deploy-bot: docs publish queued after merge (deploy #6789).
ci-bot: linkcheck passed on branch after fixes.
lina (docs): merged and published. verified live anchors for the five pages. leaving a follow-up issue to replace the hack with a slugifier config change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/214
